{{Top|leg}}
The '''Crown Court''' was a casino located in the [[Arcade (Point Nadir)|Arcade]] of [[Point Nadir]]. It was mainly known for its betting and gambling action. Sporting events were broadcast on large-screen monitors located throughout the building.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>
